children: Priority Technology Holdings agreed to be acquired by WD Capital Partners Parent for $8.05 per share in cash, with Merger Sub merging into Priority and the company becoming a wholly owned subsidiary controlled by Chairman and CEO Thomas C. Priore. Financing includes up to $160 million in equity commitments from funds advised by Searchlight Capital Partners, together with borrowings under Priority’s existing Truist revolving credit facility and available cash. Supporting Stockholders holding about 61.4% of shares signed voting and rollover agreements to back the deal. The transaction requires majority-of-the-minority approval, customary regulatory clearances, and has an outside date of Dec 18, 2027; upon closing, Priority will be delisted from Nasdaq.
